title: Ad links
intro: A separate link for each blogger or channel: see how many people it brought, how many sent a request and what one request cost.
created: The link is ready: {url} — send it to the blogger.

form.name: Blogger's nickname or channel name
form.targetHint: Site page address without the domain, e.g. /en/jobs
form.costHint: What you paid — to calculate the cost of one request
form.nameHint: A short link is made automatically, e.g. {base}/go/olen27

error.link_code_taken: This code already exists — choose another one
error.link_code_fixed: The link code cannot be changed
error.link_code_format: Code: Latin letters, digits and hyphens only, at least 3 characters
error.link_bad_target: “Leads to” must be a page address of this site starting with /
error.link_closed: The link is closed and can no longer be changed

closeConfirm: Close the link “{name}”? It will stop counting visits and move to the history. It cannot be reopened.
closedNotice: The link is closed and moved to the history.
